legal.draftNotice: Draft for review — replace this text with your own terms and have them checked by a lawyer before going live.

sections.heading: General
sections.body: By browsing this website and placing orders you agree to these terms. Please read them before using the store.

sections.heading: Orders and prices
sections.body: All prices are shown in EUR (and, where enabled, in BGN). A placed order is a proposal to buy; the contract is concluded once we confirm the order. We may decline an order if an item is unavailable or a price is clearly wrong.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Accepted payment methods are shown at checkout. Payments are processed by our payment provider; we do not store full card details.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Delivery times and costs are shown before you confirm your order and depend on the courier and destination.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal and returns
sections.body: As a consumer you may return most items within 14 days without giving a reason, in line with applicable EU consumer law. See the Refund policy for details and exceptions.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: We take care that product information is accurate but cannot guarantee it is free of errors. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update these terms; the current version always applies. For any questions use the contacts listed on the site.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: We want you to be happy with your purchase. If something is not right, you can return eligible items for a refund under the conditions below.

sections.heading: Return period
sections.body: You may request a return within 14 days of receiving your order, in line with applicable EU consumer law.

sections.heading: Conditions
sections.body: To be eligible for a refund, items should be:
points: unused and in their original condition
in the original packaging where possible
accompanied by proof of purchase (order number)

sections.heading: How to request a refund
sections.body: Contact us using the details on the site with your order number and the reason for the return. We will explain how to send the item back.

sections.heading: Refund processing
sections.body: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we process the refund to your original payment method, usually within 14 days. Return shipping costs may be borne by the customer unless the item was faulty.
